title: Valkyries Own the Glass, Stun the Aces 71-60 in Semis Game 1
meta_description: Golden State grabbed 52 rebounds to Vegas's 25 and beat the Aces 71-60 in Game 1. The glass leader did not score.
hook: The Golden State Valkyries took Game 1 of the semis 71-60 over the Las Vegas Aces, a team that beat them all three times in the regular season. The wild part? Golden State grabbed 52 rebounds to Vegas's 25. And the player who did the most damage on the glass didn't score a single point.
summary: Golden State Valkyries 71, Las Vegas Aces 60, on October 4, 2026, at Chase Center. Golden State leads the best-of-five 1-0. Body is the bot draft, edited against ESPN game 401918296. Both and-ones were real made free throws. Wilson's trip at 2:24 was two misses. The opening was cut to one hook, and 'Wilson was cooking' now has her 10 first-quarter points.
hero_image_alt: A Golden State Valkyries player in a white number 22 jersey dribbles against an Indiana Fever defender at Gainbridge Fieldhouse
hero_image_credit: Photo: Sarah Stierch / CC0. Wikimedia Commons File:Golden State Valkyries at Indiana Fever - May 2026 - Sarah Stierch 01.jpg. Taken May 22, 2026, at Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis.
unique: Golden State won the glass 52-25, with 17 offensive rebounds to Las Vegas's 2
Kiah Stokes went 0-of-3 and still had 14 rebounds, 7 offensive, and 4 blocks
Chen blocked Yamamoto at 2:58, Golden State won the challenge, and Williams scored the other way for 69-58
Wilson missed both free throws at 2:24, and Vegas then went scoreless until Brown's putback at 53.4 seconds
unverified: The Game 2 pick, and the line that Williams's three was the moment Chase Center knew, are opinion.
The lead photo is from May 22, 2026, at Gainbridge Fieldhouse, not from this game. The caption says so.

The Commons information template dates the file 2025-05-22. The filename, the category, the Gainbridge coordinates, and the ESPN schedule put the Valkyries at the Fever on May 22, 2026. There was no Valkyries at Fever game on May 22, 2025.

scorecard.info_gain: Golden State won the glass 52-25 and the offensive glass 17-2. Stokes scored 0 on 0-of-3 with 14 rebounds, 7 offensive, and 4 blocks. Chen's block of Yamamoto at 2:58 survived a coach's challenge, and Williams's layup made it 69-58. Wilson missed both free throws at 2:24, and Vegas did not score again until Brown's putback at 53.4 seconds.
